task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then optionally restore BOX_TOP to BOX_BOTTOM
assumptions: CAR robot starts at origin (0,0) approximately
BOX_TOP is on top of BOX_MIDDLE, BOX_MIDDLE is on BOX_BOTTOM
Only the top of a stack can be picked - need to temporarily move BOX_TOP
TEMP_TABLE is available as temporary storage
All objects are within interaction distance after navigation
rtdl: def task MoveMiddleBoxToInspection(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="TEMP_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
